description: Starts a research task: a question answered by reading public pages, with sources, progress and cost. Requires an API key and credits. The maximum budget is reserved, actual execution cost is charged, and unused credits are released. Returns a task id: check it with web_task_status.

limits.description: Bounds on cost, time and steps.

max_cost_usd.description: Most the task may cost, in USD. Execution budget. Reserved against account credits over MCP/HTTP with an API key; charged as a fixed package over HTTP/x402. No automatic on-chain refund.

max_duration_seconds.description: Longest the task may run, in seconds.

max_steps.description: Most decisions the planner may take.

mode.description: Only research is available: read public pages and answer.

task.description: What to find out, in plain words. Be specific about what to compare.

urls.description: Pages to read first, up to 5. Public http or https urls only.

name: web_task_start
